text: Tasks is Scout's to-do list. A call back, a records request, a bill to close: it all lands here, so nothing depends on memory or sticky notes.
The red number on Tasks is what you owe today, overdue tasks included.
The purple number is tasks you're only watching.
Open Tasks.
The one thing to remember: start every day on Expired, then work Active.
Your tasks are sorted by time, in these tabs.
Click Expired. These are past their due date, so they come first.
Each card says when it was due.
Click Active. This is what's due now.
Urgent sits at the top: anything marked urgent, overdue, or due within a day.
Everything else is under Normal. This one Scout made on its own: a bill left open last night.
Each card shows when to start, when it's due, and what it's linked to. Click a link to jump to that pet or client.
Mark done, Move, and the x to remove it are right on the card. Each has its own video.
Click the title to open the whole task.
Here are the notes, who's watching, and further down, the full history.
Back to list.
Future holds tasks that start tomorrow or later.
Unassigned is work waiting on a team's queue, like the client liaison queue. Anyone on that team can take it.
Watching is work someone wants you to keep an eye on. Only the person it's assigned to, or whoever made it, can close it.
Sent lists every task you made, for yourself or anyone else, so you can check it got done.
Completed is the history: done, removed, or closed by Scout.
Back to Active.
The Branch box narrows any tab to one office. Tasks with no office drop out of view.
The most common mistakes: working only the Active tab and missing what's overdue, and letting the red number climb for days. Remember: start every day on Expired, then work Active.
